findings.message: singleton 'App' captures scoped service 'Db' (captive dependency: App -> Db)

singleton 'Loc' resolves transient IDisposable 'Real' by hand from its injected root IServiceProvider (GetService/GetRequiredService — the service-locator anti-pattern): the root provider tracks every IDisposable it resolves and frees them only at application shutdown, so each call leaks a transient that should be scope-lived — resolve it from an IServiceScope instead (Loc -> Real)
